title_en: Tongzhou Construction Group Co., Ltd. v. Inner Mongolia Xinghua Real Estate Co., Ltd. — dispute over construction engineering contract
ruling_gist_en: 1. The determination of the validity, performance, and other issues of an agreement for debt satisfaction by transfer of property shall be based on the fundamental principle of respecting party autonomy. Generally, unless the parties explicitly agree otherwise, an agreement for debt satisfaction by transfer of property concluded after the expiration of the debt repayment period does not require the creditor to actually take delivery of the property or obtain property rights such as ownership or use rights over the property as a condition for its formation or validity. As long as the true intent of both parties is genuine and the contract content does not violate the mandatory provisions of laws or administrative regulations, the contract is valid.

full_text_en:
Tongzhou Construction General Group Co., Ltd. v. Inner Mongolia Xinghua Real Estate Co., Ltd. — dispute over a construction project contract

【Ruling Summary】

1. The determination of the validity, performance, and other issues concerning a debt settlement agreement through property transfer shall be based on the basic principle of respecting the parties' autonomy of will. Generally, unless otherwise expressly agreed by the parties, a debt settlement agreement through property transfer concluded after the expiration of the debt performance period does not require the creditor to actually receive the property or obtain property rights such as ownership or right of use as a condition for its formation or effectiveness. As long as the true intent of both parties is expressed and the contract content does not violate the mandatory provisions of laws and administrative regulations, the contract is valid.

2. A debt settlement agreement through property transfer reached between the parties after the expiration of the debt performance period may constitute a novation of the debt, i.e., the creation of a new debt with the simultaneous extinguishment of the old debt; it may also constitute a settlement of the new debt, i.e., the creation of a new debt while the old debt remains. Based on the concept of protecting creditor's rights, a novation of the debt generally requires a clear mutual agreement by the parties to extinguish the old debt. Otherwise, the nature of a debt settlement agreement through property transfer reached after the expiration of the debt performance period should generally be a settlement of the new debt.

3. In the case of a settlement of the new debt, the old debt is not extinguished before the new debt is performed; the old and new debts coexist in a connected and parallel state. Only after the new debt is legally valid and fully performed, and the debt performance obligation is completed, does the old debt become extinguished.

4. Where the creditor and debtor have reached a debt settlement agreement through property transfer and the new and old debts coexist, the determination of whether the creditor's right is realized shall be based on whether the debtor has comprehensively performed its obligations in accordance with the agreement. If the new debt is not performed upon maturity, rendering the purpose of the debt settlement agreement through property transfer unachievable, the creditor is entitled to request the debtor to perform the old debt, and the exercise of this right does not require the debt settlement agreement through property transfer to be invalid, revoked, or rescinded as a precondition.

Civil Judgment of the Supreme People's Court
(2016) Supreme People's Court Final Civil Judgment No. 484

Appellant (original defendant, counterclaim plaintiff): Inner Mongolia Xinghua Real Estate Co., Ltd., domiciled at the 4th Floor of Chenghua Group, Zhaowuda South Road, Saihan District, Hohhot, Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region.
Legal representative: Chen Ying, Chairperson of the Board.
Agent ad litem: Yang Xiaomin, lawyer of Inner Mongolia Huiling Law Firm.
Agent ad litem: Su Xiaowei, intern lawyer of Inner Mongolia Huiling Law Firm.

Appellee (original plaintiff, counterclaim defendant): Tongzhou Construction General Group Co., Ltd., domiciled at No. 34 Xinjin Road, Jinsha Town, Tongzhou District, Nantong City, Jiangsu Province.
Legal representative: Zhang Xiaohua, Chairperson of the Board.
Agent ad litem: Yan Jinhua, Deputy Manager of the Business Department of the Company.
Agent ad litem: Li Yong, lawyer of Beijing Yingyuan Law Firm.

The appellant Inner Mongolia Xinghua Real Estate Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Xinghua Company) appealed to this Court against the civil judgment of the Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region High People's Court (2012) Inner Mongolia First Instance Civil Judgment No. 38 in the case of dispute over a construction project contract with the appellee Tongzhou Construction General Group Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Tongzhou Construction General). After this Court accepted the case on July 6, 2016, it formed a collegial panel in accordance with the law and held a hearing. Chen Ying, the legal representative of Xinghua Company, and its agents ad litem Yang Xiaomin and Su Xiaowei, as well as the agents ad litem of Tongzhou Construction General, Yan Jinhua and Li Yong, appeared in court to participate in the proceedings. The case has now been concluded.

Xinghua Company's appeal requests: 1. To revoke Item 1 of the first-instance judgment according to law; 2. To amend the judgment according to law so that Xinghua Company pays Tongzhou Construction General an outstanding project payment of RMB 13,022,759, and that Xinghua Company does not pay interest to Tongzhou Construction General before the judgment (during the second-instance hearing, Xinghua Company clarified that Xinghua Company does not pay interest to Tongzhou Construction General for the period before the first-instance judgment was rendered, i.e., interest should be paid from December 18, 2015); 3. The litigation costs for the original claim at first instance and second instance shall be borne by Tongzhou Construction General. Facts and reasons: First, the first-instance judgment omitted evidence in determining the amount of project payments already paid by Xinghua Company. Xinghua Company submitted the "Agreement on Payment of Project Payment through Property Transfer" during the first-instance hearing, which expressly stipulated that Xinghua Company would offset RMB 10.95 million of project payment owed to Tongzhou Construction General with the 9th floor of Building A of the Fortune Building. Because prior to the filing of this lawsuit at first instance, Xinghua Company and Tongzhou Construction General negotiated to change the 9th floor of Building A to the 10th floor, and Tongzhou Construction General did not agree. Thereafter, Xinghua Company ceased the change of floors and informed Tongzhou Construction General. This "Agreement on Payment of Project Payment through Property Transfer" has not been rescinded by the parties, nor has it been confirmed invalid or revoked by the court, so it is binding on both parties, and the property already belongs to Tongzhou Construction General. Therefore, this RMB 10.95 million should be recognized as project payments already paid by Xinghua Company. The first-instance court avoided mentioning the "Agreement on Payment of Project Payment through Property Transfer" and did not recognize the RMB 10.95 million as paid project payment, constituting omission of evidence. Second, the first-instance judgment's determination that Xinghua Company pays interest on the outstanding project payment from February 20, 2011, is unclear in facts and erroneous in the application of law. (1) The "Construction Project Construction Contract" signed by the parties has clear provisions on the payment of project payments after the progress payments. Prior to the filing of this lawsuit, Xinghua Company had already overpaid the progress payments. According to the contract, the amount of the remaining project payment needed to be determined through audit, and payment was due 30 days after the audit. However, Tongzhou Construction General disagreed with the audit, insisted on payment of the remaining project payment based on its unilaterally prepared "Settlement Statement," and refused to deliver the project completion acceptance materials. The parties reached a deadlock over this, and it was only during the first-instance proceedings of this case that the court commissioned an audit, which was the time when the conditions for determining and paying the remaining project payment under the contract were met. Moreover, because the audit was conducted during the litigation, the amount of the remaining project payment was confirmed by the court, so the time for payment of the remaining project payment should start after the first-instance judgment. (2) Where the parties had very clear provisions on how to calculate and pay the remaining project payment, the first-instance court's application of Article 18 of the Supreme People's Court's "Interpretation on Issues Concerning the Application of Law in the Trial of Cases of Disputes over Construction Project Contracts" was clearly inconsistent with the facts. The project in question was never delivered; Xinghua Company was forced to enter the property gradually to avoid losses from defaults on downstream contracts, but the parties never signed any project delivery documents, so there could be no "date of delivery." (3) The first-instance court determined that the project delivery date was at the end of 2010, but the air conditioning unit power supply installation project, machine room alteration project, weak current installation project, and the new steel structure project on the first floor of Area A did not start until May 2011 or January 2012, and some projects have not yet been completed to date. Third, the first-instance court erred in determining the amount of the individual additional project costs and the value of materials supplied by Party A (Xinghua Company). (1) The first-instance judgment's determination of the labor cost of RMB 525,722 for the weak current installation project in the additional projects was erroneous. The full name of this weak current installation project was "Labor Cost for the New Monitoring and Weak Current Project," and this portion of the costs had already been included in the CCTV monitoring system project. Xinghua Company had submitted a written request to the first-instance court, "Request to Order Tongzhou Construction General to Provide Basis for the Additional Project and Related Budget and Final Accounts," but the first-instance court did not order Tongzhou Construction General to provide the basis, resulting in double counting of this cost. (2) Although Xinghua Company signed the statistics on the value of materials supplied by Party A of RMB 24,568,708.65 as organized by the first-instance court, it expressly noted that these figures were interim reconciliations. There were still some materials supplied by Party A that Xinghua Company was unable to reconcile with Tongzhou Construction General. The first-instance court's final determination that the value of materials supplied by Party A was RMB 24,568,708.65 constitutes unclear findings of fact.

Tongzhou Construction General responded that, first, Xinghua Company presented the "Agreement on Payment of Project Payment through Property Transfer" at first instance with the purpose of proving its intention to perform the payment obligation, not to claim that it had already offset the project payment, and the agreement had not been performed, so it could not offset the paid project payment. Second, although the parties agreed in the special terms of the "Construction Project Construction Contract" that the project payment would be paid 30 days after being submitted to an audit department recognized by both parties, the parties ultimately failed to reach an agreement on the audit department. As for how to calculate and pay the project payment at that point, the parties did not agree, so the first-instance court's determination that the contract was unclear on this point and its application of Article 18 of the Supreme People's Court's "Interpretation on Issues Concerning the Application of Law in the Trial of Cases of Disputes over Construction Project Contracts" were entirely correct. As for the machine room alteration and other projects, they were only additional parts after the main contract was completed, and the total amount was only RMB 830,000, so it should not affect the payment of interest on the project payment. Third, the labor cost of RMB 525,722 for the weak current installation project in the additional projects and the CCTV monitoring system installation project were two separate and independent projects, and the confirmation of the costs of the two projects was two years apart, so it was impossible for them to be included in each other. Fourth, the first-instance court's determination of the amount of processed materials was based on the payment vouchers signed and confirmed by both parties. Xinghua Company did not present any evidence at first instance to deny the payment vouchers signed by both parties. Even if it had new evidence, since it failed to provide it during the more than three years of the first-instance proceedings, it should be deemed to have waived the corresponding right. In summary, Tongzhou Construction General requested that Xinghua Company's appeal be dismissed.

Tongzhou Construction General filed the following claims in the original lawsuit at first instance: 1. Order Xinghua Company to pay Tongzhou Construction General the outstanding project payment of RMB 59,423,053; 2. Order Xinghua Company to pay interest on the outstanding project payment (calculated from February 20, 2011, to the date of actual payment at the bank loan interest rate for the corresponding period); 3. Order Xinghua Company to pay liquidated damages of RMB 11,594,336; 4. Xinghua Company shall bear all litigation costs of this case. Xinghua Company filed a counterclaim requesting: 1. Order Tongzhou Construction General to provide the project completion acceptance report and complete project completion materials for the project in question; 2. Order Tongzhou Construction General to return the 350-square-meter shop on the first floor of Area A of the Hohhot Water Supply Fortune Building and one 30-square-meter office on the first floor of the service building, and to pay losses for the rental of the shop from February 20, 2011, to September 20, 2012, in the amount of RMB 997,500 (5 yuan x 350 square meters x 570 days = 997,500 yuan). If immediate return was not possible, order Tongzhou Construction General to pay rental losses until the actual return date.

The first-instance court found the following facts: On June 28, 2005, Xinghua Company and Tongzhou Construction General signed a "Construction Project Construction Contract," under which Xinghua Company contracted out the construction of the Hohhot Water Supply Building (hereinafter also referred to by the parties as the "Water Supply Fortune Building" or "Fortune Building") to Tongzhou Construction General. The contract stipulated: I. Project content: General contracting of civil engineering and installation work (except as otherwise agreed by the parties and professional equipment installation). II. Scope of project contracting: All quantities of work shown on the drawings of the Hohhot Water Supply Building project (except as otherwise agreed by the parties). III. Contract period: Commencement on July 8, 2005, completion on November 30, 2006. ... V. Contract price: Tentatively RMB 60 million (subject to the final project settlement). Special terms, Article 6, Item 23: Settlement of this project shall be based on construction drawings plus project visa, applying the 2004 "Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region Construction Consumption Quota and Base Price," "Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region Decoration Consumption Quota and Base Price," and the 2004 "Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region Installation Consumption Quota and Base Price" (Vol. 12). Fee collection shall follow the 2004 "Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region Construction Project Fee Calculation Rules" and related supporting documents. During settlement, civil engineering and installation work shall be charged according to the fee collection categories stipulated by the state, and measure project fees and various overheads shall be calculated according to regulations.

On July 1, 2005, Xinghua Company prepared the "Bidding Documents," inviting bids by restricted invitation for the civil engineering work of the Water Supply Building. Article 26.5 of the "Bidding Documents" stated: This invitation to bid only asks for the bid rate for civil engineering work. On July 12, 2005, Tongzhou Construction General prepared the "Bid Documents" and submitted a bid, with a bid quote rate of 24.56%. On July 14, 2005, Xinghua Company and the bidding agency issued a "Letter of Acceptance of Bid" to Tongzhou Construction General, confirming it as the successful bidder. On the same day, Xinghua Company issued the "Confirmation of Award of Bid" and "Notice of Result of Award of Bid" to the Hohhot Construction Project Bidding Management Office and other bidders, respectively. On July 18, 2005, the Hohhot Construction Project Bidding Management Office endorsed the "Notice of Award of Bid for Construction Project" for record filing. The notice stated the bid content: see bidding documents; bid price: 24.56%. On July 28, 2005, the parties signed the "Construction Project Construction Contract" and filed it for record with the Hohhot Construction Project Bidding Management Office. The contract stipulated: I. Project name: Hohhot Water Supply Building; Project content: General contracting of civil engineering and installation work (except as otherwise agreed by both parties and professional equipment installation). II. Scope of project contracting: All quantities of work shown on the drawings of the Hohhot Water Supply Building project (except as otherwise agreed by both parties). III. Contract period: Commencement on July 18, 2005, completion on November 20, 2006. ... V. Contract price: Tentative price of RMB 50.4 million, bid rate of 24.56%. Special terms, Article 23: Settlement of this project shall be based on construction drawings plus project visa, applying the 2004 "Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region Construction Consumption Quota and Base Price," "Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region Decoration Consumption Quota and Base Price," and the 2004 "Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region Installation Consumption Quota and Base Price" (Vol. 12). Fee collection shall follow the 2004 "Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region Construction Project Fee Calculation Rules" and related supporting documents. During settlement, civil engineering and installation work shall be charged according to the fee collection categories stipulated by the state, and measure project fees and various overheads shall be calculated according to regulations.

After the contract was signed, Tongzhou Construction General entered the site and completed the construction. The project in question did not undergo completion acceptance, and Xinghua Company began using it at the end of 2010.

The first-instance court commissioned an appraisal of the civil engineering and installation project costs (excluding the CCTV monitoring system, vehicle management system, and additional project works) for the project in question. Yibo Project Management Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Yibo Company) issued a review and appraisal report (Neiyubo Appraisal Character [2013] No. 02) on March 10, 2014, with the appraisal opinion: civil engineering cost of RMB 96,477,172.76, installation cost of RMB 8,706,173, totaling RMB 105,183,345.80. Both Xinghua Company and Tongzhou Construction General raised objections. The first-instance court commissioned Yibo Company to conduct a supplementary appraisal. Yibo Company then issued the "Appraisal Opinion on Project Cost" (Neiyubo Appraisal Character [2015] No. 01) on October 10, 2015, with the appraisal opinion: (A) Cost based on bid document rate (including 3.5% social security fees): civil engineering: RMB 99,154,997; installation: RMB 12,380,189; total: RMB 111,535,186, of which social security fees: RMB 111,535,186 / 1.0344 / 1.048 x 3.5% = RMB 3,601,058. (B) Cost based on contract agreement (including 3.5% social security fees): civil engineering: RMB 101,049,789; installation: RMB 12,380,189; total: RMB 113,429,978, of which social security fees: RMB 113,429,978 / 1.0344 / 1.048 x 3.5% = RMB 3,662,234.

On September 21, 2009, the parties agreed to settle the CCTV monitoring system at RMB 820,000 and the vehicle management system at RMB 200,000, totaling RMB 1,020,000.

From May 2011 to January 2012, the parties settled the additional projects: air conditioning unit power supply installation project: RMB 95,000; machine room alteration project: RMB 150,000; weak current installation labor cost: RMB 525,722; new steel structure project on the first floor of Area A: RMB 60,000; total additional project payment: RMB 830,722.

The amount of project payments already paid by Xinghua Company was RMB 59,211,582 (RMB 58,511,582 + RMB 50,000 + RMB 100,000 + RMB 550,000), and the value of materials supplied by Party A was RMB 24,568,708.65.

The first-instance court held that the "Construction Project Construction Contract" signed by the parties on July 28, 2005, and filed for record with the Hohhot Construction Project Bidding Management Office, did not violate the provisions of laws and administrative regulations and should be valid.

I. Regarding the basis for Tongzhou Construction General's claim that Xinghua Company should pay it RMB 59,423,053 in project payment and corresponding interest:

First, regarding the issue of project cost. The project constructed by Tongzhou Construction Group had been completed, and although it had not undergone final acceptance, Xinghua Company had already put it into use. Therefore, Tongzhou Construction Group's claim for Xinghua Company to pay the outstanding project payment should be supported. Yubo Company had issued a supplementary appraisal conclusion on the cost of the civil engineering and installation works involved in the case. The civil engineering fee rates were determined based on the bid document rates and the quota rates respectively, while the installation engineering fee rates were all determined based on the quota rates. Article 23 of the special terms of the contract filed by both parties stipulated that the fee rates should adopt quota rates, which was inconsistent with the civil engineering bidding and winning bid rate of 24.56%. Article 46, Paragraph 1 of the Tendering and Bidding Law of the People's Republic of China stipulates: "The tenderer and the winning bidder shall, within 30 days from the date of issuance of the notice of award, enter into a written contract in accordance with the tender documents and the bid documents of the winning bidder. The tenderer and the winning bidder shall not enter into any other agreement that deviates from the substantive content of the contract." In this case, civil engineering works underwent tendering and bidding. The project cost for civil engineering should be determined based on the winning bid rate of 24.56%. Therefore, the first appraisal conclusion in Yubo Company's [2015] No. 01 Expert Conclusion should be adopted, i.e., the cost of the civil engineering and installation works involved is RMB 111,535,186. As to Xinghua Company's claim that the quantity of formwork in the appraisal conclusion had not been verified by it, Yubo Company clearly stated in the appraisal opinion that all quantities in this report had been verified and agreed upon by both parties. Therefore, Xinghua Company's claim cannot be sustained. Xinghua Company argued that the fee rate for installation works should also be based on the bid rate. Given that installation works were not subject to tendering and bidding, and Xinghua Company's tender documents only required quotation of the civil engineering fee rate, and Tongzhou Construction Group's bid also covered the civil engineering fee rate, the fee rate for the installation works involved should be based on the quota rate agreed upon by both parties in the contract. Xinghua Company's claim cannot be sustained. Xinghua Company argued that social security fees should be deducted. Article 4 of the Measures of the Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region on the Collection and Management of Social Security Fees for Construction Projects stipulates: "Construction entities undertaking new construction, renovation, expansion, maintenance, and technological transformation projects within the administrative region of the autonomous region shall pay social security fees for construction projects to the social security fee management institution for construction projects. The construction entity shall pre-pay the social security fees for construction projects before applying for a construction permit for the project; and settle the social security fees for construction projects before completing the recordation for project completion acceptance. The settlement procedures shall serve as a condition for handling the recordation for project completion acceptance." Accordingly, social security fees shall be paid by the construction entity to the social security fee management institution. Therefore, the social security fees in this case should be deducted. Xinghua Company's claim is established.

Second, regarding the amount of project payments already made. On November 12, 2015, the court of first instance organized the parties to reconcile the amounts already paid. The undisputed amount of project payments already made by both parties was RMB 58,511,582. There were five disputed items: (1) A payment of RMB 50,000 made by the Yellow River Diversion Office on behalf of Xinghua on February 12, 2007; (2) A payment of RMB 100,000 made by the Yellow River Diversion Office on behalf of Xinghua on July 12, 2007; (3) A suspension fee of RMB 30,000 on June 17, 2006; (4) A vehicle offset payment of RMB 230,000 by Xu Guiqiu on December 12, 2008; (5) A house offset payment of RMB 600,000. Regarding item (1), Tongzhou Construction Group claimed that on February 12, 2007, the Yellow River Diversion Office paid RMB 50,000 on behalf of Xinghua. Xinghua Company acknowledged this. The court of first instance confirmed it. Regarding item (2), Tongzhou Construction Group claimed that on July 12, 2007, the Yellow River Diversion Office paid RMB 100,000 on behalf of Xinghua and submitted corresponding evidence. Xinghua Company stated that the actual amount paid by the Yellow River Diversion Office was unclear. The court of first instance held that the receipt for RMB 500,000 stated that the company made payments in installments, and this time the payment was RMB 100,000, which could be paid first. Combined with the credit slip, Tongzhou Construction Group actually received RMB 100,000 as project payment. The court of first instance confirmed this. Regarding item (3), because Xinghua Company had no evidence to prove that it had paid the parking fee of RMB 30,000, and Tongzhou Construction Group did not acknowledge it, the court of first instance did not confirm this fee. Regarding item (4), because Xu Guiqiu and Xinghua Company had other contracted works, it could not be proven that the vehicle offset payment of RMB 230,000 was directly related to this case. Therefore, Xinghua Company's claim was not supported. Regarding item (5), because the parties had reached an agreement on the occupancy of the house and agreed to offset the project payment at RMB 550,000, the court of first instance confirmed this.

In summary, the amount of project payments already made by Xinghua Company was RMB 59,211,582 (RMB 58,511,582 + RMB 50,000 + RMB 100,000 + RMB 550,000).

On the same day, the court of first instance organized the parties to verify the materials supplied by Party A (the owner). Regarding the materials supplied by Party A, Tongzhou Construction Group provided a summary table of materials supplied by Party A, showing that the value of such materials was RMB 24,568,708.65, which could be offset against the project payment. In its cross-examination, Xinghua Company argued that this was only an interim reconciliation, not a final result, and claimed that the value of the materials supplied by Party A was approximately over RMB 25 million. The court of first instance held that Xinghua Company's claim that the materials supplied by Party A were approximately over RMB 25 million lacked sufficient evidence. Tongzhou Construction Group acknowledged the value of the materials supplied by Party A as RMB 24,568,708.65, a figure that had been verified by both parties. The court of first instance adopted this figure. Therefore, the court of first instance determined that the value of materials supplied by Party A by Xinghua Company was RMB 24,568,708.65, which could be offset against the project payment.

Therefore, the outstanding project payment owed by Xinghua Company to Tongzhou Construction Group was RMB 26,004,559.35 [RMB 111,535,186 (civil engineering and installation) + RMB 1,020,000 (CCTV monitoring system, vehicle management system) + RMB 830,722 (additional project payment) - RMB 3,601,058 (social security fees) - RMB 59,211,582 (project payments already made) - RMB 24,568,708.65 (value of materials supplied by Party A)].

Finally, regarding the issue of interest. Article 17 of the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on Issues concerning the Application of Law for the Trial of Cases of Disputes over Construction Project Contracts stipulates: "If the parties have agreed on the standard for calculating interest on overdue project payments, the agreement shall be followed; if there is no agreement, interest shall be calculated based on the same type of loan interest rate issued by the People's Bank of China for the same period." Article 18 stipulates: "Interest shall be calculated from the date when the project payment is due. If the parties have not agreed on the payment time, or the agreement is unclear, the following times shall be deemed as the payment due time: (1) If the construction project has actually been delivered, the date of delivery shall be the due time; ..." Therefore, Xinghua Company shall pay Tongzhou Construction Group interest on the above outstanding project payment. Regarding the starting date for calculating interest, the parties agreed that the project cost would be submitted to an audit department acceptable to both parties for audit. However, ultimately, no agreement was reached on the audit department. This should be considered as an unclear agreement on the payment time. Therefore, the interest calculation should preferably start from the date of actual delivery of the project, i.e., the end of 2010. Since Tongzhou Construction Group filed the lawsuit claiming that interest should be calculated from February 20, 2011, this claim should be supported. Tongzhou Construction Group's claim that the interest rate should be based on the same type of loan interest rate of the People's Bank of China for the same period does not violate the law. The interest rate for the outstanding project payment should be calculated based on the same type of loan interest rate of the People's Bank of China for the same period.

II. Regarding the basis for Tongzhou Construction Group's claim for liquidated damages of RMB 11,594,336 from Xinghua Company.

Tongzhou Construction Group claimed that, pursuant to Article 35.1 of the special terms of the contract between the parties, because Xinghua Company had delayed payment, it should pay liquidated damages at twice the loan interest rate for the same period on the overdue project payment. Tongzhou Construction Group did not provide sufficient evidence to prove that Xinghua Company had delayed payment. Xinghua Company did not acknowledge this. Tongzhou Construction Group's claim cannot be established. The court of first instance did not support it.

III. Regarding whether Tongzhou Construction Group shall deliver to Xinghua Company the project completion acceptance report and complete project completion documents.

Article 61, Paragraph 1 of the Construction Law of the People's Republic of China stipulates: "A construction project delivered for completion acceptance must meet the prescribed quality standards for construction projects, have complete technical and economic data for the project, a signed warranty certificate for the project, and meet other completion conditions stipulated by the state." Article 16 of the Regulations on Quality Management of Construction Projects stipulates: "After receiving the completion report of a construction project, the construction entity shall organize the design, construction, engineering supervision, and other relevant entities to carry out completion acceptance. The completion acceptance of a construction project shall meet the following conditions: (1) Completion of all contents specified in the design and contract of the construction project; (2) Having complete technical archives and construction management data; (3) Having entry inspection reports for the main construction materials, building components and fittings, and equipment used in the project; (4) Having quality qualification documents signed by the survey, design, construction, engineering supervision, and other entities respectively; (5) Having a warranty certificate signed by the construction entity. Only after a construction project has passed completion acceptance may it be delivered for use." Article 32.1 of the general terms of the contract between the parties stipulates: "When the project meets the conditions for completion acceptance, the contractor shall, in accordance with the relevant regulations of the state on completion acceptance of construction projects, provide the contractee with complete completion data and a completion acceptance report. If the parties agree that the contractor shall provide completion drawings, the delivery date and number of copies shall be agreed upon in the special terms." Therefore, submitting the project completion report and completion data is a statutory obligation of the contractor and an obligation agreed upon in the contract between the parties. Tongzhou Construction Group shall deliver to Xinghua Company the project completion report and completion data. Xinghua Company's counterclaim is established and should be supported.

IV. Regarding whether Tongzhou Construction Group occupies a 350-square-meter shop on the first floor of Tower A of the Water Supply Building and a 30-square-meter office on the first floor of the property management building, and whether it should return the properties and compensate for the corresponding rental loss. Because Xinghua Company admitted that it had used the project involved at the end of 2010 and did not have sufficient evidence to prove that Tongzhou Construction Group occupied the above-mentioned properties, Xinghua Company's counterclaim cannot be established.

In summary, part of Tongzhou Construction Group's claims in the main action and part of Xinghua Company's counterclaims are established. The court of first instance, in accordance with Article 60 of the Contract Law of the People's Republic of China, Article 46, Paragraph 1 of the Tendering and Bidding Law of the People's Republic of China, Article 61, Paragraph 1 of the Construction Law of the People's Republic of China, Article 16 of the Regulations on Quality Management of Construction Projects, Articles 17 and 18 of the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on Issues concerning the Application of Law for the Trial of Cases of Disputes over Construction Project Contracts, and Articles 148, Paragraphs 1 and 3 of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, entered the following judgment: (1) Xinghua Company shall, within thirty days from the date the judgment takes effect, pay Tongzhou Construction Group the project payment of RMB 26,004,559.35 and interest thereon (calculated from February 20, 2011, until the date of full payment, at the same type of loan interest rate of the People's Bank of China for the same period); (2) Tongzhou Construction Group shall, within thirty days from the date the judgment takes effect, deliver to Xinghua Company the completion report and completion data for the project involved; (3) Tongzhou Construction Group's other claims are dismissed; (4) Xinghua Company's other counterclaims are dismissed. If the obligation to pay money or other obligations is not performed within the period specified in the judgment, interest on the debt during the period of delayed performance or a surcharge for delayed performance shall be doubled in accordance with Article 253 of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China. The court acceptance fee for the main action is RMB 425,873, to be borne by Tongzhou Construction Group in the amount of RMB 269,931 and by Xinghua Company in the amount of RMB 155,942; the court acceptance fee for the counterclaim is RMB 6,887.50, to be borne by Xinghua Company; the preservation fee is RMB 5,000, to be borne by Tongzhou Construction Group; the appraisal fee is RMB 473,325, to be borne equally by the parties.

During the second instance trial of this court, Xinghua Company lawfully submitted new evidence in support of its appeal: First, a Report dated May 19, 2011, from the Second Engineering Department of Tongzhou Construction Group's Hohhot Branch to Xinghua Company, which stated: "The outstanding project payment is approximately RMB 62,218,595 (to be determined after audit) ...". Second, Explanations on the Incomplete Electrical, Water Supply and Drainage, and Civil Engineering Works of the Water Supply Fortune Building, signed by Xinghua Company's legal representative Chen Ying and Tongzhou Construction Group's Deputy Manager of the Operations Department Zhai Xuefeng, dated April 7, 2013. The above two pieces of evidence, combined with other relevant evidence submitted by Xinghua Company in the first instance, were intended to prove that the parties had a clear agreement on the time for payment of the project payment, and that as of April 7, 2013, some parts of the electrical, water supply and drainage, and civil engineering works had not yet been completed. Therefore, it was wrong to take the end of 2010 as the delivery time for the project involved. This court organized the parties to exchange evidence and conduct cross-examination. Tongzhou Construction Group did not object to the authenticity and legality of the above two pieces of evidence but argued that they could not prove the purpose that Xinghua Company sought to prove.

Based on the evidence submitted by the parties during the first and second instance trials and subject to cross-examination, this court makes the following determination regarding the facts disputed by the parties in the second instance: Article 26 of the special terms of the Construction Project Construction Contract involved, titled "Payment Terms for Project Payment (Progress Payment)", stipulates: "During the construction period of decoration and installation works, the contractee shall pay the contractor progress payments at 70% of the completed work volume on a monthly basis. After completion acceptance, Party B shall submit the project settlement statement to an audit department acceptable to both parties, and the audit shall be completed within 30 working days. The contractee shall pay the contractor the project payment within 30 working days to reach 95% of the total project cost after audit."

On September 17, 2011, Tongzhou Construction Group submitted to Xinghua Company a Preliminary (Final) Budget for Labor Costs of Weak Current Installation, quoting RMB 584,135. Xinghua Company's legal representative Chen Ying approved on October 12, 2011: "Agree to settle at 10% discount." Furthermore, regarding the settlement of project payments for other items in the supplementary projects, Xinghua Company's legal representative Chen Ying signed and approved payment of RMB 150,000 on the Preliminary (Final) Budget for Equipment Room Modification submitted by Tongzhou Construction Group on January 12, 2012; signed and approved payment of RMB 60,000 on the Preliminary (Final) Budget for Additional Steel Structure Works for Zone A on the First Floor submitted by Tongzhou Construction Group on June 13, 2011; and signed and approved payment of RMB 95,000 on the Preliminary (Final) Budget for Air Conditioning Unit Power Supply Installation submitted by Tongzhou Construction Group on May 23, 2011. Tongzhou Construction Group prepared a Summary Table for Settlement of Supplementary Projects on December 16, 2011.

On January 13, 2012, Xinghua Company (Party A) and the Second Engineering Department of Tongzhou Construction Group's Hohhot Branch (Party B) entered into a Property Offset Against Project Payment Agreement, which stipulated: "Regarding the Water Supply Fortune Building project undertaken by Party B for Party A, the parties have agreed through negotiation to offset the project payment with the 9th floor of Tower A of the building in question, and the agreement is as follows: 1. Location of the offset property: At the corner of Xinghua East Street to the south and Fengzhou Road to the west, Hohhot, Fortune Building Tower A, 9th floor. ... The agreed offset price for the property is RMB 7,500 per square meter, totaling RMB 10,950,000. 2. Party B will use three residential units owned by Tongzhou Construction Group Co., Ltd. Hohhot Branch, located at ... for a total price of RMB 1,527,450. ... After deducting the residential unit price of RMB 1,527,450, the amount offset against the project payment is RMB 9,422,550. The parties will handle the formalities and enter into a formal contract upon settlement." In the second instance, Xinghua Company acknowledged that the 9th floor of Tower A of Fortune Building had not yet undergone initial registration of property ownership or any transfer registration.

As for the two pieces of evidence submitted by Xinghua Company in the second instance of this court, this court holds that they are not relevant to the facts to be proved and therefore are not adopted.

This court holds that, based on the parties' appeal requests, defense opinions, and relevant evidence, and after confirmation by the parties during the trial, the issues in dispute in the second instance of this case are: (1) Whether the offset of the project payment against the 9th floor of Tower A of the Water Supply Fortune Building should be included in the project payments already made. (2) Whether the court of first instance duplicated the calculation of the labor costs of RMB 525,722 for the weak current installation works as part of the payable project payment. (3) Whether the value of materials supplied by Party A determined by the court of first instance is correct. (4) From what date should interest on the outstanding project payment be calculated.

I. Regarding whether the offset of the project payment against the 9th floor of Tower A of the Water Supply Fortune Building should be included in the project payments already made.

First, offsetting a debt with a property is one of the methods of debt satisfaction and an arrangement between the parties on how to settle the debt. Therefore, the determination of the validity, performance, and other issues of a debt settlement agreement by offsetting property should be based on the principle of respecting the parties' autonomy of will. Generally, unless the parties expressly agree otherwise, a debt settlement agreement by offsetting property entered into after the debt repayment period has expired does not require the creditor to actually take possession of the offset property or acquire ownership, right to use, or other property rights in the offset property for its formation or effectiveness. As long as the parties' expression of intention is genuine and the content of the contract does not violate mandatory provisions of laws and administrative regulations, the contract is valid. In this case, the Property Offset Against Project Payment Agreement entered into by Xinghua Company and the Second Engineering Department of Tongzhou Construction Group's Hohhot Branch on January 13, 2012, was a genuine expression of the parties' intention and did not violate any provisions of laws or administrative regulations. Therefore, the agreement is valid.

Second, a debt settlement agreement by offsetting property reached after the debt repayment period has expired may constitute a novation of debt, i.e., creating a new debt while simultaneously extinguishing the old debt; or it may constitute a settlement of new debt, i.e., creating a new debt that coexists with the old debt. Based on the principle of protecting claims, novation of debt generally requires a clear agreement by the parties to extinguish the old debt. Otherwise, a debt settlement agreement by offsetting property reached after the debt repayment period has expired should generally be characterized as a settlement of new debt. In other words, if a debt settlement agreement by offsetting property entered into by the creditor and the debtor after the debt repayment period has expired does not provide for the extinguishment of the original monetary payment obligation, it should be deemed that the parties have added another method of performing the debt settlement, rather than extinguishing the original monetary payment obligation. In this case, the parties entered into the Property Offset Against Project Payment Agreement, but did not agree that the corresponding amount of project payment debt would be extinguished as a result. Therefore, the nature of the agreement should be a settlement of new debt agreement.

Thirdly, the so-called discharge refers to the act of performance that realizes the content of the debt in accordance with the purpose of the obligation, and its original intent is to perform as agreed. If the debtor does not actually perform the agreement on debt satisfaction through property transfer, the old debt between the creditor and the debtor is not extinguished. That is to say, in the case of satisfaction of a new debt, the old debt is not extinguished before the new debt is performed, and the old debt and the new debt coexist in a connected state; only after the new debt is legally valid and fully performed, and the debt satisfaction obligation is completed, does the old debt become extinguished. Accordingly, in this case, based solely on the fact that the parties signed the "Agreement on Offsetting Project Payment with Property," it is insufficient to determine that the offsetting of the project payment with the 9th floor, Tower A, Water Supply Fortune Building as stipulated in the agreement should be included as paid project payment, thereby extinguishing the corresponding amount of the project payment debt. Whether it should be counted as paid project payment and correspondingly deducted from the amount of overdue project payment should also be determined based on the actual performance of the agreement. In this regard, on the one hand, Article 9 of the Property Law of the People's Republic of China provides: "The establishment, alteration, transfer, and extinction of real rights in immovable property shall become effective upon registration according to law; without registration, it shall not become effective, unless otherwise provided by law." Accordingly, unless otherwise provided by law, the transfer of ownership of a building becomes effective on the date of registration of the ownership transfer according to law. In this case, after the signing of the "Agreement on Offsetting Project Payment with Property," the ownership of the 9th floor, Tower A, Water Supply Fortune Building was not registered in the name of Tongzhou Construction General, so Tongzhou Construction General did not acquire ownership of the 9th floor, Tower A, Water Supply Fortune Building. On the other hand, Xinghua Company had already put the property into use at the end of 2010, so Tongzhou Construction General had in fact delivered the property including the 9th floor, Tower A, Water Supply Fortune Building. Xinghua Company has no sufficient evidence to overturn this fact, nor evidence to prove that the 9th floor, Tower A, Water Supply Fortune Building is currently under the actual control or use of Tongzhou Construction General, so it cannot be determined that the 9th floor, Tower A, Water Supply Fortune Building was actually delivered to Tongzhou Construction General. It can be seen that the 9th floor, Tower A, Water Supply Fortune Building was neither delivered to Tongzhou Construction General for actual possession and use, nor was the ownership transfer registered under the name of Tongzhou Construction General. Xinghua Company did not perform the obligations stipulated in the "Agreement on Offsetting Project Payment with Property," so Tongzhou Construction General's claim for the corresponding project payment that was intended to be offset by property under the agreement has not been extinguished.

Finally, the parties shall follow the principle of good faith and fully perform their obligations as agreed. This is the basic principle to be followed in contract performance and also the basic philosophy that the people's court should uphold when handling contract performance disputes. Accordingly, when the debt has become due, the debtor shall pay the debt in full and on time as agreed. When the creditor and debtor have reached an agreement on debt satisfaction through property transfer, and the new debt and the old debt coexist, determining whether the creditor should realize the claim by demanding performance of the new debt or the old debt should also take this as the starting point and foothold. If the new debt is not performed when due, causing the purpose of the agreement on debt satisfaction through property transfer to be unattainable, the creditor has the right to request the debtor to perform the old debt; moreover, the exercise of this right does not require the invalidation, revocation, or rescission of the agreement on debt satisfaction through property transfer. In this case, the project was delivered at the end of 2010, and Xinghua Company should have settled the project payment promptly and paid it as agreed, but Xinghua Company failed to perform that obligation as agreed. On the contrary, with respect to part of the overdue project payment, Xinghua Company attempted to perform by offsetting with some properties, and after negotiation with Tongzhou Construction General, they signed the "Agreement on Offsetting Project Payment with Property." In this regard, Xinghua Company should also actively perform its corresponding obligations in accordance with the provisions of the agreement. However, after signing the "Agreement on Offsetting Project Payment with Property," Xinghua Company once attempted to change the location of the property to be offset as agreed in the agreement. Without the consent of Tongzhou Construction General, Xinghua Company neither promptly and actively delivered the agreed property to Tongzhou Construction General nor resumed performance of the old debt, i.e., paying the corresponding overdue project payment to Tongzhou Construction General. After Tongzhou Construction General filed this lawsuit claiming the project payment from Xinghua Company, the parties still negotiated on how to perform the "Agreement on Offsetting Project Payment with Property" to offset the corresponding project payment, but no consensus was reached. From the terms of the "Agreement on Offsetting Project Payment with Property," Tongzhou Construction General signed the agreement with the intention of accepting delivery of the 9th floor, Tower A, Water Supply Fortune Building from Xinghua Company, obtaining ownership or possession and use of the property, thereby realizing its corresponding claim for project payment. Although the agreement did not explicitly stipulate a performance period, more than four years have passed since the signing of the agreement, and Xinghua Company's project payment debt had long become due, yet Xinghua Company still has not delivered the property stipulated in the agreement to Tongzhou Construction General, nor can it register the ownership transfer for it. In summary, Xinghua Company did not perform the obligations stipulated in the "Agreement on Offsetting Project Payment with Property," its conduct violates the principle of good faith, and the purpose of Tongzhou Construction General in signing the "Agreement on Offsetting Project Payment with Property" cannot be realized. Under these circumstances, Tongzhou Construction General filed this lawsuit requesting Xinghua Company to directly pay the outstanding project payment, which is in line with the spirit of the law and the facts of this case, and should be upheld.

Furthermore, although Xinghua Company submitted the "Agreement on Offsetting Project Payment with Property" in the first instance, its stated purpose of proof was that Xinghua Company had the willingness to perform and pay the project payment, and did not claim to use it to offset the project payment or as paid project payment. Therefore, the first instance judgment's failure to address the agreement based on this does not constitute a violation of legal procedure.

In summary, the amount of project payment to be offset by the 9th floor, Tower A, Water Supply Fortune Building as stipulated in the "Agreement on Offsetting Project Payment with Property" should not be counted as paid project payment. The first instance court's determination and order that Xinghua Company should pay the corresponding outstanding project payment to Tongzhou Construction General is not improper, and Xinghua Company's ground of appeal on this issue cannot be sustained.

2. On the issue of whether the first instance judgment double-counted the labor cost of RMB 525,722 for the weak current installation project as payable project payment

In the first instance, Tongzhou Construction General submitted evidentiary materials regarding the settlement of new items including the weak current installation project. Although Xinghua Company raised objections in both the first instance and second instance, arguing that it constituted double-counting, the evidence it submitted, such as the "Settlement Statement for the (New Part) of the Water Supply Building, Yubo Fortune Building Center Project" and the "Professional Project Cost Approval Form for Hohhot Water Supply Building," were insufficient to prove the facts it claimed. According to Article 90 of the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on the Application of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, Xinghua Company shall bear the adverse consequences of this.

Moreover, looking at the CCTV monitoring system project and the weak current installation project, the former was a professional installation project in the normal performance of the contract, and the parties settled it in September 2009; the latter was one of the supplemental items formed after the project was actually put into use, and the parties settled it in October 2011. Unless there is evidence to prove that the parties agreed that the latter would not be separately paid project payment, there is no factual or legal basis for claiming that the CCTV monitoring system project payment of RMB 820,000 includes the project payment for the latter. In addition, on the "Preliminary (Final) Account Statement" for the labor cost of the weak current installation project submitted by Tongzhou Construction General, Xinghua Company's legal representative, Chen Ying, instructed on October 12, 2011: "Agree to settle after a 10% discount." It can be seen that Xinghua Company agreed to pay the labor cost of the weak current installation project at the settlement price submitted by Tongzhou Construction General after a 10% discount, and this amount is calculated as RMB 525,722.

In summary, the first instance judgment's inclusion of the labor cost of RMB 525,722 for the weak current installation project as payable project payment is not improper, and Xinghua Company's claim that it constituted double-counting cannot be sustained.

3. On the issue of whether the value of materials supplied by Party A as determined by the first instance judgment is correct

With respect to the materials supplied by Party A, in the first instance, Xinghua Company submitted evidence such as purchase and sale contracts and payment vouchers, claiming that the value of materials supplied by Party A was approximately over RMB 25 million. In response, Tongzhou Construction General acknowledged the value of the materials supplied by Party A as RMB 24,568,708.65. Xinghua Company recognized RMB 24,568,708.65, while at the same time in its cross-examination stated that this was only a periodic reconciliation and not the final result. As for the portion exceeding RMB 24,568,708.65 claimed by Xinghua Company, it further specified the amount as RMB 1,502,077.35 in the second instance and submitted evidence such as purchase and sale contracts and payment vouchers. However, it expressly stated that none of these were submitted as new evidence in the second instance, and this evidence is insufficient to prove that the corresponding materials were provided to Tongzhou Construction General for use in the construction of the project, or that there is no overlap with the materials supplied by Party A already acknowledged by Tongzhou Construction General in the first instance. Tongzhou Construction General also did not accept these in the second instance. Therefore, Xinghua Company shall bear the corresponding adverse consequences. The first instance court's determination that the value of materials supplied by Party A recognized by both parties of RMB 24,568,708.65 was used as the price of materials supplied by Party A that can be set off against project payment is legally sound, and Xinghua Company's ground of appeal cannot be sustained.

4. On the issue of from when interest on the overdue project payment should be calculated

This Court finds that although the parties stipulated in the "Construction Project Construction Contract" that 95% of the project price would be paid within 30 working days after the audit department approved by both parties completed the audit within 30 working days, the parties did not agree on the selection of the audit department, so the payment time stipulated in the contract was actually impossible to determine. Therefore, the first instance judgment's finding that the payment time should be deemed as not clearly stipulated is not improper.

Article 18 of the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on Issues Concerning the Application of Law in the Trial of Cases of Disputes over Construction Project Contracts stipulates: "Interest shall be calculated from the date when the project payment becomes due. If the parties have not agreed on the payment time or the agreement is unclear, the following times shall be deemed as the time when payment is due: (1) If the construction project has been actually delivered, the date of delivery; ..." Therefore, it is legally sound to determine that the interest on the overdue project payment in this case should be calculated from the actual date of delivery of the project. Although the project was not completed and accepted, it was actually delivered to Xinghua Company for possession and use at the end of 2010. Therefore, taking the end of 2010 as the starting point for calculating interest on the overdue project payment is consistent with the facts of this case. Of course, since Tongzhou Construction General claimed in its first instance complaint to calculate interest from February 20, 2011, a date later than the end of 2010, the parties have the right to dispose of their civil rights, so the interest on the overdue project payment should be calculated from February 20, 2011.

However, after the actual delivery and use of the project, Tongzhou Construction General performed construction of some supplemental projects according to the parties' negotiation, and corresponding settlements were carried out from May 2011 to January 2012, involving a total of RMB 830,722 in new project payments. To also calculate interest on this portion uniformly from February 20, 2011, is inconsistent with the principle established in Article 18 of the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on Issues Concerning the Application of Law in the Trial of Cases of Disputes over Construction Project Contracts. Although Xinghua Company's grounds in its appeal regarding the incorrect starting point for interest on overdue project payment cannot be sustained, since it appealed the first instance judgment's handling of the interest calculation starting point for the overdue project payment, the issue of the interest calculation starting point for the new project payment of RMB 830,722 should also be addressed together. Considering that the amount of each supplemental project payment is relatively small, Tongzhou Construction General prepared a "Summary Table of Settlement of Supplemental Items" on December 16, 2011. The legal representative of Xinghua Company, Chen Ying, signed on the four supplemental items at different times, but the latest signature time was January 12, 2012. Therefore, this Court determines that the interest on the new project payment of RMB 830,722 shall be calculated from January 13, 2012. For the remaining overdue project payment of RMB 25,173,837.35 (RMB 26,004,559.35 - RMB 830,722), interest shall still be calculated from February 20, 2011.

In summary, Xinghua Company's grounds of appeal cannot be sustained, but its appeal request regarding the starting point for calculating interest on overdue project payment is partially sustainable; the first instance judgment found the facts clearly and applied the law generally correctly, but there was impropriety in handling the starting point for calculating interest on part of the overdue project payment, which should be corrected. Pursuant to Article 18 of the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on Issues Concerning the Application of Law in the Trial of Cases of Disputes over Construction Project Contracts and Article 170(1)(2) of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, the judgment is as follows:

1. Affirm Items 2, 3, and 4 of the Civil Judgment (2012) Nei Min Yi Chu Zi No. 38 of the Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region High People's Court;

2. Amend Item 1 of the Civil Judgment (2012) Nei Min Yi Chu Zi No. 38 of the Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region High People's Court to read: "Inner Mongolia Xinghua Real Estate Co., Ltd. shall, within thirty days from the effective date of this judgment, pay Tongzhou Construction General Group Co., Ltd. project payment of RMB 26,004,559.35 and interest thereon (interest on RMB 25,173,837.35 shall be calculated from February 20, 2011 until the date of full payment; interest on RMB 830,722 shall be calculated from January 13, 2012 until the date of full payment; both at the same period loan interest rate of the People's Bank of China)."

Court acceptance fee for the first instance of RMB 425,873, counterclaim acceptance fee of RMB 6,887.50, and preservation fee of RMB 5,000 shall be executed in accordance with the first instance judgment. Court acceptance fee for the second instance of RMB 99,690.80 shall be borne by Inner Mongolia Xinghua Real Estate Co., Ltd.

This judgment is final.
